goal: Press Start and wait for the loading to finish, so that the text 'Hello World!' is displayed.
notes: After Start the page shows a loading indicator for several seconds; wait for it rather than pressing anything else.

checks.loading: A loading indicator or the text 'Loading...' is visible

loaded.when: The text 'Hello World!' is displayed below the heading

app_error.when: An error message or an error page is shown
